title: Citrus Sorceress
description: A purple-skinned woman in a flowing black and green dress stands in profile, holding a glowing red blood orange. She is surrounded by oversized floating citrus slices, large green leaves, and sparkling magical particles against a deep teal background.
prompt: A mystical purple-skinned woman in profile wearing a flowing black dress with green fabric accents, holding a glowing blood orange in her hand. She stands amid giant floating citrus slices including blood oranges and lemons, surrounded by oversized vibrant green leaves and sparkling magical particles and lightning effects. Dreamlike surreal fantasy scene with rich deep teal background, painterly style with visible brushwork.
